messages.subject: Re: Merge implementation
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

the C code in GNU R actually only performs a very small part of what the the merge.data.frame() function does so we have replaced this C code with a few lines of R code. This means that the merge function is now available in the latest builds. If you're using Maven, just make sure you have Renjin 0.7.0-RC8-SNAPSHOT as a dependency. For other modules, like the Debian package (renjin-debian-package), the simple GUI (renjin-studio), or the script engine (renjin-script-engine) you can find the jars at http://nexus.bedatadriven.com/content/repositories/renjin-latest/org/renjin/. Make sure you get the ones with the most recent date!

To make it easier to refer to one of our official builds, the latest one (build 26) now ensures that the version and build number of Renjin are included in the welcome message when you start Renjin from the command line or via the GUI. The following example shows build number 26 of Renjin version 0.7.0-RC8-SNAPSHOT:

Renjin 0.7.0-RC8-SNAPSHOT-b26
Copyright (C) 2013 The R Foundation for Statistical Computing
Copyright (C) 2014 BeDataDriven
>

Let us know if you experience any issues with the merge function!

Regards,

Maarten-Jan

messages.subject: Re: renjin prodlim package
messages.body_plain:
Hi Jim,
Sorry for the late reply:
The class "org.renjin.cran.prodlim.prodlim" would be where Renjin expects to find the java class file containing the transpiled C/Fortran code.

You can find the build log for this package here:
http://packages.renjin.org/packages/prodlim.html

And it looks like our C-to-Java translator failed because we don't have an emuluation function for "srand".

Caused by: java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: No matching method for srand
	at org.renjin.gcc.translate.MethodTable.resolve(MethodTable.java:92)
	at org.renjin.gcc.translate.TranslationContext.resolveMethod(TranslationContext.java:82)
	at org.renjin.gcc.translate.TranslationContext.resolveMethod(TranslationContext.java:87)
	at org.renjin.gcc.translate.FunctionContext.resolveMethod(FunctionContext.java:61)
	at org.renjin.gcc.translate.call.StaticCallTranslator.writeCall(StaticCallTranslator.java:27)
	at org.renjin.gcc.translate.FunctionTranslator.visitCall(FunctionTranslator.java:108)
	... 28 more

You can try to implement it here:
https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin/blob/master/tools/gnur-runtime/src/main/java/org/renjin/gnur/RenjinCApi.java

And see if you can rebuild the package.

I've opened a ticket for the issue here:
https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin/issues/73

Best,
Alex
